## Summary

Describe the problem solved and the approach taken.

## Solution classification

- [ ] Traditional or educational baseline
- [ ] Optimised or modern implementation
- [ ] Test, documentation or repository maintenance

## Correctness

- [ ] Public behaviour and assumptions are documented.
- [ ] Edge cases and invalid inputs are covered.
- [ ] New or changed code has tests.
- [ ] Optimised code is cross-checked against a transparent baseline where practical.

## Complexity and trade-offs

State the expected time and space complexity and explain any important trade-offs.

## Quality checks

- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes.
- [ ] `pytest --cov=general_reference --cov-report=term-missing` passes.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or generated large files are included.
- [ ] Relevant README, catalogue or changelog entries are updated.

## Evidence

Include concise output, benchmarks or references needed to review the change.
